user.title: KOSPEL PPE4
user.description: Enter the address of the heater's Wi-Fi module. The app talks to it over plain HTTP on the local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Wi-Fi module (for example 192.168.8.1 in setup mode).
data_description.port: HTTP port of the module; usually 80.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure KOSPEL PPE4
reconfigure.description: Update the address of the heater's Wi-Fi module.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read registers from the module. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network as the heater.

init.title: KOSPEL PPE4 options
init.description: Polling interval, fault decoding and register overrides. The default register map was recovered from the vendor app; units are known for the live block, the physical assignment is inferred.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the live register blocks are read.
data_description.fault_encoding: How the fault register is decoded: no fault handling, bitmask (bit n = catalogue code n+1) or a single code.
data_description.fault_register: Register that carries the fault word. Leave empty when unknown.

error.invalid_registers: The register overrides are not valid JSON or contain an unknown key.
error.fault_register_required: A fault register is required when fault decoding is enabled.
